notes:
FEATURES
• Local personal-data detection: names and postal addresses from context, with birth dates and license/ID numbers read from field labels.
• Four new categories: Personal names, Postal addresses, Dates of birth, License & ID numbers. Share a screenshot and Financial details enable them by default.
• A bundled GLiNER PII Small model runs offline and only loads when personal fields are enabled.

ENHANCEMENTS
• Stored presets gain the new categories when they match an unmodified preset; Custom selections stay untouched.
• The export audit's --ocr mode stays model-free and compares the text identifier categories only.
• Settings explains the local model and the field-label behavior.

FIXES
• verify_export(run_ocr=True) no longer raises KeyError on the retired Broad preset.
• Keep house numbers in labeled address values and suppress duplicate NER boxes inside the same field.
• Update the stale preset names in the product notes.

OPTIMIZATIONS
• Personal detection runs once per standard scan; enhanced and color passes skip the model.
• The model is fetched and SHA-verified at build time, not downloaded at runtime.

The Windows installer remains unsigned; Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning. Builds include the local PII model and are larger than 2.0.7.
